_comments.outputDir: Where notes are written. ~ expands to your home dir. Notes are grouped into per-channel folders.
_comments.provider: auto | anthropic-api | claude | copilot | codex | extractive. 'auto' picks the first available from providerOrder.
_comments.model: Optional model override passed to the provider CLI/API. Empty = provider default.
_comments.summaryStyle: ragnar | executive | detailed | bullets | study. Controls the note template + voice.
_comments.includeTranscript: Append the full cleaned transcript at the bottom of each note.
_comments.concurrency: How many videos to process in parallel. Keep low (1-3) to avoid YouTube rate limits.
_comments.whisperFallback: If true and a video has no captions, download audio and transcribe with Whisper (requires openai-whisper installed).
_comments.extractive: Pure-JS no-LLM fallback summary so you always get a usable note even with no CLI/API.
